doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: What she still wants to do: Peterson, Jamal, the Bergmans and a new label
summary: She wants to record with Oscar Peterson and Ahmad Jamal, do a Bergmans songbook with Johnny Mandel, and leave Verve.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Are there things . . . what do you foresee . . . well, what would you like to do still that you haven‘t done?

I want to go fishing so bad. Musically, right? I want to record with Oscar Peterson. I want to sit down and just sing with him. I want to do the same with Ahmad Jamal. I want to do the . . . for the writing team, the husband-and-wife writing team; they‘re brilliant. I want to do that songbook with Johnny Mandel. They wrote all that good music. What are their names? Good lord, CRS is really taking on. The Bergmans, you know the Bergmans songwriting team, husband and wife?
I probably know their songs, but I may not know their name.

Oh, child, they‘ve got all kind of stuff, and they came to see me a couple of times in Hollywood. I told them I wanted to do their songbook. They were thrilled, and Johnny Mandel. But I‘ve got to get another record company, because well, Johnny didn‘t part company with them on good terms, which just comes down to they owe him a lot of money. I want to eventually. I‘m going to go with another label. I‘ve got a couple of offers, very good offers, but I don‘t want to get strung out. I just want to do, one year do two albums, and that‘s it. That‘s enough, because you find yourself being, feeling close in, and they got to know too much of your business, and they know where you are before you know. I had to look at my itinerary. They know where I‘m supposed to go and all that, you know. I don‘t like that. I‘m not used to that.
Yeah. I‘m the control freak myself. Don‘t tell me where I‘m going.
Is there anything else that you‘d like to do?
Mm-mm, not really. I just want to make good music. If I keep getting these things every year, I just want to have one whole wall for my nominations. [laughs]
You can build it. You can erect it yourself.

I don‘t want much. I like a lot of peace. I like peace. I need to clean up my house and get some of this dust around here. I‘m getting ready to put the carpet down in there. I don‘t want to go out of town for that, but I‘d be here. So much to do, get all these records and tapes organized. Shoo. Want to hear one of my songs?
